verdict.rationale: Hightouch's docs say Customer Studio "builds traits and audiences on top" of resolved warehouse identities, and marketers build audiences in a no-code UI. That gives a thin basis for computed traits usable in targeting. Nothing in the pack shows predictive scores such as LTV, churn or purchase propensity calculated on profiles. AI Decisioning picks the next best message, channel and timing, which is an adjacent feature and does not count as predictive scoring. Missing for 10: any documented predictive LTV/churn/propensity scoring, detail on how computed traits are defined and calculated, evidence that traits and scores can be used as audience filters, and independent corroboration.
